name: Dream/Strung - Blossoming Love
source:
A beautiful young woman who keeps being abducted meets another feminine figure. Little does she know, their fates are intertwined. Follow the adventure of our two protagonists as they get into and away from many unusual situations; slowly nurturing their love for each other.

The adventure is about two characters meeting for the first time, getting to know one another as they grow an unusual relationship.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1828040/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一个不断被绑架的美丽年轻女子遇到了另一个女性人物。她却不知道，他们的命运已经交织在一起。跟随我们的两位主角的冒险经历，了解他们进入和离开许多不寻常的情况；慢慢地培养着彼此的爱。

这部冒险故事讲述了两个角色第一次见面，并在发展出不寻常关系的过程中相互了解的故事。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1828040/]Steam[/url]]
